info.name: Deliveroo Catalogue Picking API
info.description:
Part of the Deliveroo Retail Platform Suite. The Catalogue API lets grocery and non-food retailers manage a master catalogue of up to 30,000 items per brand, publish product data and availability across retail sites, and override item prices at the site level. Authentication uses an OAuth 2.0 client credentials bearer token.

Contact Support:
 Name: Kin Lane
 Email: kin@apievangelist.com
